reasoning_content: Production server is running (8 workers, preloaded). Next, I'll access it. In production, force_ssl is set to true, so requests over http will result in a 301 redirect to https. Let me check with curl -I.

action.command: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET http://localhost:3001/ -> HTTP %{http_code}, redirect: %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3001/; curl -sk -o /tmp/prod_home.html -w "GET https://localhost:3001/ -> HTTP %{http_code}, %{size_download} bytes\n" https://localhost:3001/ 2>&1; grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/prod_home.html | head -1
